text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival!
For the sake of the fans who always support them,
the Umamusume put on all kinds of fun competitions.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"What could this sound be!?"
Let's do this! Fry up that kakiage—!!

text_block_list.name: Golshi Fan
text_block_list.text:
W-What sport is this?!
Don't leave me behind, Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing a mini-live♪
Come gather 'round, y'all!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO!
Tarumae-chaaaan!!"

Lively, heartwarming interactions with favorite Umamusume...
Everyone passing by wears a smile.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Thank you for waiting.

text_block_list.name: Attendees
text_block_list.text: G-Gentildonna...!

text_block_list.name: Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
That intensity is insane~...!
No wonder she pushed even Orfe to the brink...

text_block_list.name: Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
Look at her, brimming with that much confidence.
It's way too intimidating...
Perhaps due to her aura of power... despite drawing plenty of attention, an empty space opened up around Gentildonna as the crowd kept its distance.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

This is a rare opportunity to interact with fans.
I'd love for Gentildonna's fans to deliver their feelings directly as well, but...
choice_data_list: Why don't you try talking with the fans?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: If it is gratitude for the support I have received, I express it at every opportunity.
choice_data_list: Maybe one of your fans wants to talk to you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case,
they'll likely come over from their side.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. If you can't even voice it
unless I reach out to offer my help—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you understand.
I have no taste for half-hearted efforts.

It was an assertive rationale typical of someone who never hesitated.
Even so, I didn't think the feelings of fans who chose not to step forward were half-hearted either.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Receiving applause is most agreeable.
After all, it is proof that I have demonstrated my power.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: “However, if you wish to step beyond that…… the rest depends on your own power.”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Fifteen minutes remaining until deadline.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Are there any other Umamusume who wish to participate in the 'Fan-Inclusive Obstacle Relay'?"
The Fan-Inclusive Obstacle Relay is a unique Fan Thanksgiving event where Umamusume team up with their fans.

The fans team up to clear several obstacles and pass the baton to the Umamusume running the anchor leg.
Every year, it has a friendly and lively atmosphere.
choice_data_list: (This might be a good chance to connect with the fans...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Very well, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Either way,
participating in some kind of event is mandatory.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: There's no fun in racing Umamusume against each other when the outcome is already obviousâ

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I'll be looking forward to seeing
what this chemical reaction of yours brings about...
choice_data_list: (So my ulterior motives were totally obvious, huh...)

text_block_list.text: "Next, I should reach out myself so fans can join in more easily."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text: —Wait, Gentil-san's event...?
choice_data_list: Would you like to join us?

text_block_list.text:
While looking for participants on campus, I spotted someone
wearing the same motif as Gentildonna's racing outfit and called out to them.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm very honored, but...
...I don't have any sports experience, so I don't know if I'll be of much help..."
choice_data_list: I see... Well, maybe next time!

text_block_list.name: Confident Fan
text_block_list.text:
I hold high school track and field records!
Leave anything running-related to me!

text_block_list.name: Brawny Fan
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by Lady Gentildonna,
I have honed these muscles...!
I am certain they will be of service to you!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho.
How dependable.
As expected of people who came forward on their own, the gathered fans were brimming with confidence. Then—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...!
Am I still in time to join...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry about earlier!
But still... I really want to try!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
Suppression of myself, not challenging anything...
Gentildonna-san never taught me to do that!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If that is so, simply carry it out.
With grace.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Let us claim them.
—Our respective victories.
Once the Fan-Inclusive Obstacle Relay began... Gentildonna's team advanced with unstoppable momentum.

text_block_list.name: Confident Fan
text_block_list.text: Uryaaaaaaaaa...!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Team Gentildonna!
They're tearing up the slope at tremendous speed!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
What an adorable little race.

text_block_list.name: Brawny Fan
text_block_list.text: Hmphhh... Nrrrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Team Gentile is lifting those steel drums
effortlesslyâ!
This is amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, what a surprise.
You're quite strong, aren't you... Hohoho.
choice_data_list: (I'm being treated like a total baby...)

text_block_list.text:
With Gentildonna watching on,
Team Gentil passes through in 1st place.
And then—
We reached the stage where the fan who stepped up last was sprinting with all their might to hand the baton to the anchor, Gentildonna.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
Phewww...!
Aaaahhhhh...!!

That fan wasn't fast on their feet.
Yet, their desperate determination struck a chord.
Just a little bit more effortâ

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna-san!!
Pass!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Good work.

—From that point on, it was over in a flash.
Allowing no one to close the gap, Team Gentildonna claimed an overwhelming victory.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
I did iiiiiiit!!
I won!! Woooaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You all did splendidly.
It was quite an amusing experience.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
I managed to pass the baton...
to Ms. Gentile...! *sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, isn't this event supposed to be...
where fans and Umamusume have fun together?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's... totally hardcore...
Scary...

Paying no heed to the bewildered audience...
she clapped with all her might for her rejoicing fans.
(Skiiiiid...)

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aah...!
I-I lost—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
...!
Gentildonna...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
Stand up, run...! 
U-Uwaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Gentile!
Please win...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

—It was a breathtaking run.
Gentildonna overtook everyone from dead last to cross the finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay!!
As expected of Lady Gentile~~!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. If it weren't for me,
things would've been much easier—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You have learned something
from me, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You ran, and the team won.
It doesn't matter what anyone else thinks.
How do you think you ought to be?"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
...!
Stand tall and puff out my chest...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...
Allow me to offer one piece of advice.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Train your core—both your abs and your back.
—Keep your chest held high at all times, as befits yourself."
